```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace
library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(pdt)
library(openxlsx)
library(data.table)

DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""


# Terugblik data (imputed version)
tb<-fread(
  paste0(DataDir,"2026-04-01_TerugblikIMP_export_260331.csv"),
  sep=";", 
  fill=TRUE)
tb<-as.data.frame(tb)

# remove B21 and B23_original
tb<-tb[tb$Completed==1,]
tb<-tb[!tb$Studienummer %in% c("B21", "B23_original"),]
tb<-tb[!is.na(tb$Studienummer),]
table(tb$Studienummer)

```

*phase vars*
phase_FSE = if_else(sent < T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date, "A", "B"),
phase_cis4_school = if_else(sent < T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date + weeks(4), "A", "B"),
phase_satisf_health = if_else(sent < T2_Inzichtsgesprek_date + weeks(6), "A", "B")


# B23 
```{r}
B23<-tb[tb$Studienummer=="B23",]
B23<-B23[!is.na(B23$phase_FSE),]
df<-B23


# fSE -----------------------------------------------------
test_res <- AB_permutation_distancing_test(
      as.factor(df$phase_FSE),
      df$fse_imp,
      test_statistic = "B-A",
      test_statistic_function = "mean",
      reps_max = 2000,
      alpha_p_box_test = 0.1,
      max_statistic_p_box_test = 2.7,
      no_duplicates = FALSE,
      remove_NA_series_above_k = TRUE)

    # tables for counts
    phase_tab <- table(df$phase_FSE)
    
    # outcome vectors
    y_all <- df$fse_imp
    y_A   <- df$fse_imp[df$phase_FSE == "A"]
    y_B   <- df$fse_imp[df$phase_FSE == "B"]
    
   totaal<- tibble(
      ## test results
      p_value = test_res$p_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      effect  = test_res$effect_size_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR    = test_res$ar1[1],
      k       = test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR_k    = test_res$ar1[test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test],
      
      
      ## participant characteristics
      Age = mean(df$leeftijd_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sex = mean(df$Geslacht, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ## counts
      length_A = if ("A" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["A"] else 0,
      available_A = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_FSE == "A"),
      length_B = if ("B" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["B"] else 0,
      available_B = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_FSE == "B"),
      available_AB = available_A + available_B,
      percentage_130 = available_AB/1.30,
      
      
      ## outcome descriptives
      mean_overall = mean(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_overall   = sd(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_A = mean(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_A   = sd(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_A  = var(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_B = mean(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_B   = sd(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_B  = var(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_diff = mean_B - mean_A,
      var_ratio     = var_B / var_A,
      log_var_ratio = log(var_B) - log(var_A)
    )
  
fse<-totaal %>% mutate(
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    effect  = round(effect, 4),
    AR = round(AR, 3),
    AR_k = round(AR_k, 3),
    
    mean_overall = round(mean_overall, 2),
    sd_overall   = round(sd_overall, 2),
    
    mean_A = round(mean_A, 2),
    sd_A   = round(sd_A, 2),
    var_A  = round(var_A, 3),
    
    mean_B = round(mean_B, 2),
    sd_B   = round(sd_B, 2),
    var_B  = round(var_B, 3),
    mean_diff = round(mean_diff, 2),
    var_ratio     = round(var_ratio, 3),
    log_var_ratio = round(log_var_ratio, 3),
    percentage_130 = round(percentage_130, 0)
  )
```

    y_B   <- df$satisfaction_imp[df$phase_satisf_health == "B"]
    
   totaal<- tibble(

  )

  test_res <- AB_permutation_distancing_test(

    y_B   <- df$health_imp[df$phase_satisf_health == "B"]
    
   totaal<- tibble(
      ## test results
      p_value = test_res$p_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      effect  = test_res$effect_size_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR    = test_res$ar1[1],
      k       = test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test,
      AR_k    = test_res$ar1[test_res$k_selected_based_on_Box_test],
      
      
      ## participant characteristics
      Age = mean(df$leeftijd_start, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sex = mean(df$Geslacht, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      ## counts
      length_A = if ("A" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["A"] else 0,
      available_A = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_satisf_health == "A"),
      length_B = if ("B" %in% names(phase_tab)) phase_tab["B"] else 0,
      available_B = sum(!is.na(df$start) & df$phase_satisf_health == "B"),
      available_AB = available_A + available_B,
      percentage_130 = available_AB/1.30,
      
      
      ## outcome descriptives
      mean_overall = mean(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_overall   = sd(y_all, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_A = mean(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_A   = sd(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      var_A  = var(y_A, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      mean_B = mean(y_B, na.rm = TRUE),

    )
  
health<-totaal %>% mutate(
    p_value = round(p_value, 4),
    effect  = round(effect, 4),
    AR = round(AR, 3),
    AR_k = round(AR_k, 3),
    
    mean_overall = round(mean_overall, 2),
    sd_overall   = round(sd_overall, 2),
    
    mean_A = round(mean_A, 2),
    sd_A   = round(sd_A, 2),
    var_A  = round(var_A, 3),
    
    mean_B = round(mean_B, 2),
    sd_B   = round(sd_B, 2),
    var_B  = round(var_B, 3),
    mean_diff = round(mean_diff, 2),
    var_ratio     = round(var_ratio, 3),
    log_var_ratio = round(log_var_ratio, 3),
    percentage_130 = round(percentage_130, 0)
  )

# summary data B23
```{r}

fse$origin <-"FSE"
fse2$origin<-"FSE_2sided"
satisfaction$origin <-"satisfaction"
health$origin <-"health"

test_fse<- fse %>%    select(
origin,
        mean_A,
      mean_B,
      mean_diff,
      var_ratio,
      effect,
      p_value,
      percentage_130,
      available_B
    ) 

test_fse2<-fse2 %>%    select(
origin,
        mean_A,
      mean_B,
      mean_diff,
      var_ratio,
      effect,
      p_value,
      percentage_130,
      available_B
    ) 
  
  
test_sat<-satisfaction %>% select(
origin,
        mean_A,
      mean_B,
      mean_diff,
      var_ratio,
      effect,
      p_value,
      percentage_130,
      available_B
    ) 
test_health<- health %>% select(
origin,
        mean_A,
      mean_B,
      mean_diff,
      var_ratio,
      effect,
      p_value,
      percentage_130,
      available_B
    ) 

test_tot<-bind_rows(test_fse, test_fse2, test_sat, test_health)

```
# write output ------
```{r}
wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "summary")
addWorksheet(wb, "FSE_")
addWorksheet(wb, "FSE_2")
addWorksheet(wb, "satisfaction")
addWorksheet(wb, "health_")

writeData(wb, sheet = "summary", test_tot)
writeData(wb, sheet = "FSE_", fse)
writeData(wb, sheet = "FSE_2", fse2)
writeData(wb, sheet = "satisfaction", satisfaction)
writeData(wb, sheet = "health_", health)
